failure_summary.description: Answered a clue label, related entity, or shortened name instead of the requested concrete referent or context-supported full form.
Did not recognize an unfinished quotation as asking for its exact continuation, or an acronym as asking for a feature's conventional expansion.
Shortened a context-supported publication name, omitting a component required by the expected conventional form.

patch.reasoning: Add narrow guidance for two clue forms not fully covered: quotations cut off without an ellipsis and questions asking for an acronym's expansion. The other failures are already addressed by the skill's answer-slot, referent, and name-form rules, so duplicating those rules is not warranted.

edits.target: - When an ellipsis marks omitted words in a title or phrase, use context to recover and return the missing continuation. Prefer a completion that fits the whole fragment over a prominent work or entity that matches only a shorter substring.
edits.content: - When a quoted line, sentence, title, or phrase visibly stops mid-phrase—whether marked by an ellipsis or simply cut off—treat it as a completion clue. Return the exact missing continuation at the cut, not the title or source, and verify that it completes the whole fragment.

edits.target: - Treat terse statements, quoted fragments, and incomplete phrases as information-seeking clues when appropriate. Infer the answer slot from the wording, then use the context to identify the entity or value that satisfies the clue.
edits.content: - When an acronym or initialism is named as a feature and the question asks what feature it denotes, give its conventional full name when supported by context. Do not substitute a mechanism, component, or implementation detail for the feature's name.
